Class LinuxPlatformProvider

java.lang.Object
com.faster.affinity.platform.LinuxPlatformProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:

public class LinuxPlatformProvider extends Object implements PlatformProvider
Complete Linux-specific platform provider with actual system call integration. Fixed version without fake default values.
